# Medikart - Licensed Online Pharmacy & Medicine Delivery in Pakistan

> Medikart (https://medikart.pk) is Pakistan's trusted digital healthcare network connecting patients with licensed partner pharmacies across Pakistan. Medikart provides 100% genuine prescription medicines, OTC health essentials, baby care, pediatric nutrition, and automated 30-day chronic medicine refills with rapid 2–4 hour delivery in major cities and 24–48 hour nationwide Cash on Delivery.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **Authentic Online Pharmacy:** Order genuine medicines (e.g. Panadol, Augmentin, Brufen, Disprin, Glucophage, Lipitor, multivitamins, and specialty prescription treatments) with licensed pharmacist verification.
- **Delivery Coverage in Pakistan:** 
  - Rapid Intra-City (2–4 Hours): Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, and Rawalpindi.
  - Nationwide Express Courier (24–48 Hours): Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Quetta, Sialkot, Gujranwala, Hyderabad, Abbottabad, Bahawalpur, Sargodha, Sukkur, and all other cities in Pakistan.
- **Instant Prescription Order:** Patients can upload photos or PDFs of doctor prescriptions at https://medikart.pk/instant-order for fast pharmacist review and direct home dispatch.
- **30-Day Monthly Medicine Refills:** Automated recurring subscription for chronic maintenance medications (diabetes, hypertension, cardiac care, thyroid) with free delivery and priority dispatch at https://medikart.pk/refill.
- **Flexible Payment Methods:** Cash on Delivery (COD), Visa/MasterCard debit and credit cards, 1Bill, direct internet banking, and mobile wallets (JazzCash, Easypaisa, Raast).
- **Safety & Regulatory Compliance:** 100% authentic medicines sourced strictly through licensed partner pharmacies in full compliance with Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan (DRAP) regulations. Strict zero-tolerance policy for controlled narcotics and illegal Schedule X drugs.
- **24/7 Pharmacist Support:** Direct WhatsApp assistance and prescription queries at +92 324 4489159.
